archetypes.name: dyn-oos-merit
archetypes.rationale: Merit rejection flow must remain confirmation-gated and rescue-safe.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed /combine-issues --oos prose for the merit gate. Check whether proposed low-merit items are kept out of deduplication and combination until an explicit oos-4 decision. Verify the rescue path sends named items back through deduplication and grouping before apply. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
